content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Makes wellheads and pressure control for oil wells and runs flowback crews; different product from temporary site-access matting."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Self-performs civil site grading, utilities and paving for developers; it builds sites rather than renting temporary access matting."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"HVAC, plumbing and electrical contracting for buildings; no overlap in product, service or site-access business."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Builds roads and bridges with its own asphalt and aggregates; a paving and heavy civil business, not matting rental."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Distributes plumbing, HVAC and waterworks products through branches; a distributor, not a matting maker or site-access provider."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Develops raw land into residential lots sold to homebuilders; a real estate development business, not temporary access products."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Heavy civil construction plus aggregates and asphalt for public agencies; different products and customers from matting rental."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Manufactures pre-insulated piping for district energy and pipelines; a different product, though it also sells engineered packages to energy operators."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Makes paints, coatings and specialty chemicals; a materials chemistry business unrelated to composite matting and site access."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Provides drilling, well completion and intervention services to oil operators; oilfield services differ from temporary matting and site work."}]}
